description: StarYi Go Verified Multi-Rank Puzzle Pack (30K -> 5D)

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一路边线的白子只剩 1 口气，一子提掉它！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Capture the 1-liberty white stone on the edge!
templates.hintZh: 看看边线白子旁边唯一剩下的空交叉点。
templates.hintEn: Spot the single open intersection next to the white stone.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上两颗白子紧紧挨着，快拿走它们最后一口气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Both corner white stones share one last liberty — capture them!
templates.hintZh: 这两颗白子只剩右边边线那一口气。
templates.hintEn: Both stones share the final liberty along the top edge.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：中间一排白子被包围得严严实实，一口气全提光！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: The white line in the center has 1 liberty left — capture all three!
templates.hintZh: 找一找三颗白子四周唯一没有黑子堵住的地方。
templates.hintEn: Find the single remaining liberty around the three white stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗黑子只剩一口气了！快往宽阔处长气逃出来！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Your two stones are in atari — extend into open space!
templates.hintZh: 往右侧空地长出一子，立刻变成 3 口气！
templates.hintEn: Extend right into open space to jump to 3 liberties!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：黑棋被叫吃了，但旁边白子也只剩 1 口气！抢先提掉白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: You're in atari, but a white stone is too! Capture it first!
templates.hintZh: 不要逃跑，直接提掉那颗只剩 1 口气的白子就能救出全部黑棋！
templates.hintEn: Capture the white stone with 1 liberty to save your whole group!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗白子靠得很近但还没连上！先切断并叫吃右边白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Cut between the two white stones and put the right one in atari!
templates.hintZh: 下在两颗白子正中间的断点，右边白子立刻只剩 1 口气。
templates.hintEn: Play on the cutting point between them to put the right stone in atari.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：不要把白子往中央放跑，把它抱向一路边线吃掉！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Drive the white stone onto the first line to capture it!
templates.hintZh: 从二路挡住白子往中央逃跑的路线。
templates.hintEn: Atari from the second line so White has to crawl onto the edge.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：利用上方已有的黑墙，选对打吃方向吃掉白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Choose the right atari direction to push White into your wall!
templates.hintZh: 从下方叫吃，逼白棋往上方黑墙撞上去。
templates.hintEn: Atari from below to push White right into your upper stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白子躲在二二位，先叫吃逼它进角再关门全吃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Push White into the corner door and slam it shut!
templates.hintZh: 先从外侧叫吃，白棋逃进角里后只剩一口气。
templates.hintEn: Atari from outside so White runs into the corner trap.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗黑子已经摆好门柱，从后面叫吃请君入瓮！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Your two doorposts are ready — atari White straight into the door!
templates.hintZh: 从左边叫吃白子，白子往右逃就会钻进两颗黑子的口袋！
templates.hintEn: Atari from the left so White runs right between your two stones!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：棋盘中央出现经典双打吃机会，一子叫吃两白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Spot the classic double atari in the center!
templates.hintZh: 找同时紧挨着两颗白子的那个交叉点。
templates.hintEn: Find the empty point touching both two-liberty white stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：贴着边线钻进去，同时叫吃左右两块白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Step in near the edge to put both white stones in atari!
templates.hintZh: 中间的空点正好同时威胁到左边和右边两颗白子。
templates.hintEn: The center gap threatens both left and right white stones at once.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋留下了一个致命缺口，打进去左右必吃一块！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Step into White's gap for a double atari on two groups!
templates.hintZh: 找到让左右两块白棋同时变成 1 口气的虎口点。
templates.hintEn: Play on the point that reduces both white groups to 1 liberty.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：左下黑棋被分断且只剩一口气，冷静连回救出大块！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Your group is cut and in atari — connect cleanly to survive!
templates.hintZh: 把两块黑棋连成一家，立刻拥有充足气数。
templates.hintEn: Link your endangered stones to your healthy neighbors.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：三颗黑子命悬一线，找到那颗 1 口气白子立刻提掉！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Three black stones are in atari — capture the key white stone to save them!
templates.hintZh: 注意观察包围黑子的白子中，哪一颗只剩最后一口气。
templates.hintEn: Look at the surrounding white stones — one of them only has 1 liberty!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：黑棋被围在边上，把三个空点一分为二做出两只真眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Split the 3 empty edge spaces into two unkillable true eyes!
templates.hintZh: 点在三个空点正中间，左右各留一只闪亮真眼。
templates.hintEn: Play right in the center of the three empty points.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：黑棋左角已有一只真眼，快在右边补成第二只真眼活棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: You have one eye on the left — complete the second eye on the right!
templates.hintZh: 把右边虎口补牢，别让白棋扑进来破眼！
templates.hintEn: Solidify the right eye before White destroys it.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上三目空地，下在哪里能变出两只真眼？
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Find the vital point in the corner to make two true eyes!
templates.hintZh: 拐角 1-1 正好把角上三个空点隔成两只眼。
templates.hintEn: The 1-1 corner splits the three spaces into two separate eyes.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：空荡荡的 9 路小棋盘，第一步占领正中央「天元」辐射四方！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: On an empty 9×9 board, claim the center Tengen star point!
templates.hintZh: 9 路棋盘正中央的星位叫「天元」（5-5 点）。
templates.hintEn: Tap the center star point (Tengen) at the heart of the 9×9 board.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋占了右上星位，黑棋赶快去抢占左下「金角」星位！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Claim the open bottom-left golden corner star point!
templates.hintZh: 「金角银边草肚皮」——左下角 3-3/4-4 星位还空着哦！
templates.hintEn: Corners are gold — claim the open bottom-left star point!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：切开两颗白子，同时叫吃一路边线上的白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Cut between the white stones and capture along the edge!
templates.hintZh: 从二路挡住逃跑路线，白子无处可逃。
templates.hintEn: Cut on the second line so the edge white stone cannot escape.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋沿二路伸过来偷地盘啦！快立下挡住守好自己的空！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White is sneaking along the 2nd line — block cleanly to guard your territory!
templates.hintZh: 在白棋前面一路稳稳立下挡住。
templates.hintEn: Stand down on the first line directly in front of White.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：选对第一手叫吃方向，把白子一路征到上方边线！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Choose the right first atari to ladder White to the top edge!
templates.hintZh: 封住白棋往右边中央逃跑的路，逼它朝上方边线走楼梯。
templates.hintEn: Block the center direction so White zig-zags straight into the top edge.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：上方已有黑棋接应，大胆发动征子让白棋一头撞墙！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: A friendly black stone waits ahead — start the ladder now!
templates.hintZh: 堵住右下方，把白棋往左上方己方黑子处追过去！
templates.hintEn: Block below to drive White right into your waiting friendly stone!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：直接打吃会让白棋逃跑！用一记轻灵的「枷」罩住白子！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Direct atari lets White escape — trap it with a clean Net!
templates.hintZh: 隔一格斜对角罩住，白棋往哪边冲都会只剩 1 口气。
templates.hintEn: Play diagonally across to net White — every escape runs into atari.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗白子想往中腹钻出，一招「大枷」彻底封死！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Two white stones try to break out — seal them with a Net!
templates.hintZh: 不要贴身撞上去，站在前方斜角罩住它们的两处出口。
templates.hintEn: Cap diagonally ahead of both escape lanes!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：利用两边的黑棋配合，轻轻一「枷」把白子收入囊中！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Coordinate your surrounding stones to net the white stone cleanly!
templates.hintZh: 下在白子正前方的马步/斜角位置，左右都跑不掉。
templates.hintEn: Place a loose net directly ahead of White's escape path.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：大胆送吃一子！白棋提完立刻只剩一口气，反手全提！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Sacrifice one stone in the corner to snap back the entire group!
templates.hintZh: 直接扑进白棋虎口，白棋提掉后反而自撞死胡同！
templates.hintEn: Throw a stone into White's mouth — if White captures, snap right back!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：先弃一子扑入白棋断点，引诱白棋提子后一举反提！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Throw in on the edge to trigger a 3-stone snapback!
templates.hintZh: 在一路直接扑入切断点，等白棋提子后再提回来！
templates.hintEn: Throw in on the first line, wait for White's capture, then snap back!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：叫吃角上白子，白棋如果敢粘上就会整块被吃光！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Atari the corner stones — if White connects, capture the whole group!
templates.hintZh: 先在二路分断叫吃，白棋粘上后只剩 1 口气！
templates.hintEn: Cut on the second line so connecting leaves White with 1 liberty!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一子切断叫吃，白棋粘上就全军覆没！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Cut and atari in the center — White cannot safely connect!
templates.hintZh: 看准白棋最气紧的断点打吃进去。
templates.hintEn: Cut at White's tightest shortage-of-liberties point.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：连续叫吃把白棋滚成一团“大愚形”，一口气吃光！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Chain ataris to squeeze White into a breathless clump!
templates.hintZh: 先从外侧打吃，逼白棋不断粘上变成一团。
templates.hintEn: Start with the forcing atari from the outside and keep squeezing!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一子犀利「挖」入白棋二路薄弱处，左右必吃其一！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Wedge cleanly between White's two 2nd-line stones!
templates.hintZh: 下在两颗二路白子正中间，无论白棋哪边挡另一边都会被吃。
templates.hintEn: Wedge right between the two white stones — White can't save both.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：左右两块黑棋被白棋隔开，用一记「夹」在一路/二路巧妙渡过！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Unite your two separated groups with a sharp clamp!
templates.hintZh: 下在正中间的一路要点，白棋从哪边挡都挡不住另一边。
templates.hintEn: Play at the central 1st-line clamp — whichever side White blocks, slip past the other!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：冷静立下一子，左右两块白棋同时「不入气」全被吃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the calm Crane's Leg — neither white group can approach!
templates.hintZh: 不要急着去打吃任何一边，先稳稳接回中间那颗一路黑子。
templates.hintEn: Connect calmly in the center — both sides become self-atari for White!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋摆出「直三」眼位，抢先点中中心杀棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Strike the center vital point to kill White's Straight Three!
templates.hintZh: 「敌之要点即我之要点」——直接点在三个空点正中间！
templates.hintEn: Strike the exact middle of the three empty spaces!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋角部是「曲三」，请一招点杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Kill White's corner Bent Three in one move!
templates.hintZh: 点在角上 1-1 的拐弯中心点。
templates.hintEn: Play on the 1-1 corner bend to destroy White's second eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：黑棋眼位呈「丁」字形四目，守住中心点轻松做活！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Claim the center of your T-shaped Pyramid Four to live!
templates.hintZh: 占住「丁」字交叉的正中央，立刻变出三只眼！
templates.hintEn: Occupy the center intersection of the T-shape.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋摆出「丁四」，抢占唯一要点杀掉整块白棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Strike the T-center vital point to kill White's Pyramid Four!
templates.hintZh: 下在「丁」字形四目的正中央，白棋再也分不出两只眼。
templates.hintEn: Play directly at the center of the T-shape.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：经典的「刀把五」眼形，抢占中心要点做成两眼活棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Secure the vital point inside your Bulky Five to live!
templates.hintZh: 刀背与刀柄交汇的中心点就是活棋要点。
templates.hintEn: Play at the intersection touching 3 of the 5 empty spaces.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：面对白棋的「刀把五」，点中核心要点后再跟进破眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Strike the Bulky Five's vital point and finish the kill!
templates.hintZh: 先点在刀把中心，白棋挡哪边就继续点破另一侧。
templates.hintEn: Hit the central vital point first, then follow up on White's resistance.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：十字形「梅花五」眼位，占住正中央变出四只眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the center of the Crossed Five to form four eyes!
templates.hintZh: 下在「十」字中心，四周四点全部成为独立真眼。
templates.hintEn: Claim the center of the plus sign!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一子直击白棋「梅花五」花心，白棋瞬间无法做活！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Pierce the exact heart of White's Crossed Five!
templates.hintZh: 十字形眼位的正中心是唯一的杀棋点。
templates.hintEn: Strike the dead center of the plus-shaped eye space.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：双方各剩 2 口气！千万别碰中间公气，先紧白棋外气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Both have 2 liberties — take White's outside liberty first!
templates.hintZh: 「对杀先紧外气」——先下在右边紧白棋外气！
templates.hintEn: Fill White's outer liberty on the right before touching the shared point.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：对杀紧张胶着，抢先紧掉白棋右侧外气胜出一气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Win the 3-liberty capturing race by taking the outside liberty!
templates.hintZh: 切忌先走中间公气给自己减气，先紧外侧！
templates.hintEn: Never reduce your own shared liberties first — approach from outside.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：四角占完后向下方三路「拆二」，建立稳固根据地！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Extend two spaces along the bottom 3rd line for a living base!
templates.hintZh: 在左下黑星位右侧隔两格（三路）拆二。
templates.hintEn: Extend two spaces to the right along the third line.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：左上黑棋已两子并立，按口诀「立二拆三」大步围边！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: From your 2-stone wall, leap 3 spaces along the top side!
templates.hintZh: 从两子并立处向右隔三格落子，效率拉满。
templates.hintEn: Leave three empty intersections from your 2-stone wall!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：二路先手扳入压缩白空，白棋不得不挡！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the 2nd-line hane to scoop White's edge in sente!
templates.hintZh: 贴着白棋二路拐弯扳下，然后再稳稳粘回。
templates.hintEn: Hane on the second line, then connect cleanly when White blocks.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：沿着一路巧妙扳渡，白棋敢挡就反手切断吃掉！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Hane along the 1st line to slip underneath and connect!
templates.hintZh: 紧贴左边黑棋一路扳过，白棋气紧无法阻断。
templates.hintEn: Hane on the first line — if White blocks, capture right back!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：选对打吃方向封住右侧出口，三颗白子插翅难逃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Seal the open right side so the three white stones cannot escape!
templates.hintZh: 左边已经是黑墙，必须从右边把出口彻底封死。
templates.hintEn: Your left wall is solid — seal the open right exit!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：算清整条对角线，一步步把白棋征到边线全歼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Read the whole diagonal and execute the full ladder!
templates.hintZh: 第一手从右侧封堵，之后每手紧追白棋唯一出路。
templates.hintEn: Seal from the right first, then zig-zag tightly to the edge.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一子立下稳住中路，左右白棋同时无法入气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Stand calmly in the middle so neither white group can play!
templates.hintZh: 不要贪吃左边或右边，先把中间气口立牢。
templates.hintEn: Play calmly in the center to lock both white groups out.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋虎口看似牢固，一记大胆「扑」把它撕得粉碎！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White looks connected — throw in to shatter it via snapback!
templates.hintZh: 直接扑在一路切断点，白棋提掉反而变 1 口气。
templates.hintEn: Throw in on the 1st line to force a fatal snapback.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗白子二路飞过留有断点，一子挖入必得其一！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Wedge straight into White's thin second-line shape!
templates.hintZh: 直接下在两颗二路白子正中间的空点。
templates.hintEn: Wedge directly between the two white stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋想往中央探头逃生，当头一「镇」封死出路！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Cap White's head to seal its escape completely!
templates.hintZh: 按住白棋往下方出头的正前方交叉点。
templates.hintEn: Play right in front of White's escaping head.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋角上看似有退路，巧妙切断送吃反提！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Cut off the corner and use a snapback to capture!
templates.hintZh: 先在二路切断逼白棋入气，再顺势收割。
templates.hintEn: Cut on the 2nd line so White runs out of liberties immediately.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋眼看要做出两只眼，一记一路「扑」把它变成假眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Throw in on the edge to turn White's eye into a false eye!
templates.hintZh: 直接扑在右边眼位里，白棋就算提子也只剩假眼！
templates.hintEn: Throw in on the right so capturing leaves White with a false eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋有四目宽阔空间，先从外侧一路扳缩成死形再点杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Don't rush inside — shrink from outside with a 1st-line hane first!
templates.hintZh: 记住口诀「缩小眼位再点杀」，先在一路扳缩小成直三！
templates.hintEn: Hane on the first line to shrink 4 spaces down to a dead Straight Three.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：著名的「葡萄六（花六）」死活常形，直击唯一花心杀白！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Strike the center vital point of the famous Rabbitty Six!
templates.hintZh: 找那个同时挨着 3 个内部空点的花心位置！
templates.hintEn: Target the intersection touching three other interior empty points.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：黑棋眼形是葡萄六，抢先守住花心变出三只真眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Claim the center vital point of your Rabbitty Six to live!
templates.hintZh: 敌之要点即我之要点，占住花心即活！
templates.hintEn: Occupy the center vital point before White can strike it.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上三目眼位不够活！往边线一路扳撑大成直四活棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: 3 spaces aren't safe — expand outward along the 1st line!
templates.hintZh: 向右边一路扳出，把眼位扩大成不可点杀的四目活形！
templates.hintEn: Hane outward on the first line to build a living 4-space eye!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋企图扑破黑棋角眼，冷静补成虎口做成铁两眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Defend against White's throw-in threat to secure two solid eyes!
templates.hintZh: 把右边容易被扑破的缺口稳稳补住。
templates.hintEn: Protect the vulnerable eye corner so White cannot turn it false.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋边线有五目宽敞空地，先从外侧一路扳紧气缩眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White has 5 spaces along the edge — reduce from outside first!
templates.hintZh: 切忌直接点里面给白棋做眼机会，先从一路缩小眼位！
templates.hintEn: Hane on the 1st line first to shrink the eye space before striking inside.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：双方公气多，先在角上做出一只真眼让公气全归黑棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Form one true eye in the corner so all shared liberties become yours!
templates.hintZh: 「有眼杀无眼」——先把左上角做成稳固真眼！
templates.hintEn: Complete a true corner eye — White can't enter until the very last move!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：硬紧外气慢一气！用角上二路/一路立下妙手给自己延气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Direct approach loses by 1 liberty — extend your own corner liberties!
templates.hintZh: 先在左边二路立下延气，瞬间多长出两口气！
templates.hintEn: Stand down on the left to gain extra liberties and win the race.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋有一只眼，直接紧气会输！一记「扑」破眼反杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White has an eye — throw in to destroy it and win the race!
templates.hintZh: 直接扑在白棋眼位里，逼白棋自填一口气！
templates.hintEn: Throw in inside White's eye so it ceases to be an eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：直三大眼里藏着 3 口气！护住大眼入口稳赢对杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: A 3-space big eye holds 3 liberties — seal yours to win the race!
templates.hintZh: 守住己方直三大眼入口，白棋气数远远不够！
templates.hintEn: Protect your 3-space big eye entrance to outlast White.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：四角占毕，对右上白星位下出轻灵的「小飞挂」！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Approach White's top-right star point with a Knight's Move!
templates.hintZh: 在右上白星位左下方三路（马步位置）挂角。
templates.hintEn: Play on the 3rd line a knight's move away from White's star point.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：抢先一步给左上黑星位下出「小飞守角」，兼顾角地与上边！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Enclose your top-left corner with a Knight's Move!
templates.hintZh: 在左上黑星位右侧三路马步位置守角。
templates.hintEn: Enclose on the 3rd line a knight's move to the right of your star point.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋右上星位未守角，直接「点三三」掏空角地！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White's top-right 4-4 is open — invade directly at 3-3!
templates.hintZh: 右上角三三点（Q17 / 3-3 点）是现代围棋最犀利的掏角手段！
templates.hintEn: Play directly at the top-right 3-3 point!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：施展著名的「大伸腿」，沿一路一口气捞走白棋大空！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Execute the Monkey Jump along the 1st line to scoop territory!
templates.hintZh: 沿一路小飞伸腿潜入白棋边空下方。
templates.hintEn: Leap a knight's move deep along the 1st line under White's wall.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：利用白棋边线气紧，沿一路扳入猛掏角空！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Hane onto the 1st line exploiting White's shortage of liberties!
templates.hintZh: 一路扳进去，白棋如果硬挡就会被切断反吃。
templates.hintEn: Slip onto the 1st line — White is too short of liberties to block.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：下出一手犀利的二路扳，抢走白棋边空还留先手！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the sharp 2nd-line hane to squeeze White's side territory!
templates.hintZh: 紧贴白棋二路拐弯扳下，逼白棋退让。
templates.hintEn: Hane on the 2nd line next to White's border stone.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：做不出两只真眼时，冷静立下做出「双活」平安求生！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Two eyes aren't possible — create a peaceful Seki to live!
templates.hintZh: 稳稳立在右侧，形成双方共享两口公气的双活局面。
templates.hintEn: Stand down calmly so neither side can safely approach the shared liberties.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上经典「盘角曲四」常形，直击唯一杀棋要点！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Strike the vital point of the legendary corner Bent Four!
templates.hintZh: 抢占角部 2-1 拐点，白棋无论哪边挡都只剩一只眼。
templates.hintEn: Play on the 2-1 corner vital point so White cannot split two eyes.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上宽敞但暗藏杀机！找准唯一急所做出不可点杀的活形！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Find the exact vital point in the corner to guarantee life!
templates.hintZh: 抢占角上 2-1 关键点，彻底防住白棋点杀。
templates.hintEn: Claim the 2-1 vital point before White strikes inside.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上空间紧促，下在著名的「二一路要点」妙手做活！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the famous 2-1 vital point to live in a cramped corner!
templates.hintZh: 「角上活棋二一路」——在 2-1 位置落子同时瞄准两边做眼！
templates.hintEn: Play on the 2-1 intersection to create miai for two eyes.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋角上只差一步成活！直击「二一路要点」干净杀棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Strike the 2-1 vital point before White secures corner life!
templates.hintZh: 同样是 2-1 点！点进去后白棋两翼无法兼顾。
templates.hintEn: Strike directly at the 2-1 vital point to deny White miai.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：先从外侧一路扳缩小眼位，再准确点杀白棋大龙！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Shrink from the 1st line first, then strike the fatal vital point!
templates.hintZh: 先一路扳进去压缩空间，切忌直接乱点内部。
templates.hintEn: Hane on the 1st line first to reduce White's eye space.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋外气看似够用，必须先占一路要害不让白棋做眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Take the 1st-line vital point first so White cannot make an eye!
templates.hintZh: 先从外侧一路紧气并破眼，再回手紧中间气。
templates.hintEn: Take the outer 1st-line point first to deny White's eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：抢占二路逆收大官子，防止白棋先手扳粘白白损失双倍目数！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Claim the 2nd-line reverse sente endgame before White strikes!
templates.hintZh: 对手的先手官子被我方先下到，价值翻倍！
templates.hintEn: Preventing White's sente intrusion is worth double — claim it first!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋看似连成铁板，连环「扑」破眼并紧气全歼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Throw in cleanly to strip White's eye and liberties at once!
templates.hintZh: 大胆扑进白棋虎口，白棋提子立刻掉进倒扑陷阱。
templates.hintEn: Throw in straight into White's tiger mouth to trigger a snapback!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上白棋空间较大，精准运用「缩眼 → 点杀」连招！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Combine outside eye reduction with the decisive vital point!
templates.hintZh: 先在右侧一路扳缩眼位，等白棋挡住后再点中直三要点。
templates.hintEn: Reduce from the right on the 1st line, then strike the remaining vital point.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上白棋呈「方四」潜藏做眼手段，先手扑破假眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White's corner threatens two eyes — throw in to turn one eye false!
templates.hintZh: 在角部眼位果断扑入，白棋提子后变成假眼死形。
templates.hintEn: Throw in decisively so White's corner eye collapses into a false eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：外围白棋重重包围，一子占住角部核心变出见合两眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Surrounded heavily — claim the corner key point for miai life!
templates.hintZh: 寻找同时护住角上和边线两处眼位的唯一急所。
templates.hintEn: Find the single key point protecting both corner and side eyes as miai.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：看似气紧难逃，利用连续叫吃将白棋拧成一团全歼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Turn shortage of liberties around with a ruthless rolling squeeze!
templates.hintZh: 第一步叫吃逼白棋接上，紧接着连续打吃提光！
templates.hintEn: Initiate the forcing atari sequence to clump White together and capture!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：高段级精细数气！直接紧气差一气，先在角上立下延气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: High-dan liberty counting! Extend in the corner first to win by 1!
templates.hintZh: 先给自己长出两口气，再回头轻松收紧白棋。
templates.hintEn: Gain two liberties in the corner first — direct approach loses by 1.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：右上星位遭到白棋左右双挂，冷静点守「三三」活角！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Double-approached on the 4-4! Drop calmly to 3-3 to live!
templates.hintZh: 不要急着冲断任何一边，直接守在三三点稳如泰山。
templates.hintEn: Stay calm and claim the 3-3 point to secure corner life.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：高段官子计算！一路大伸腿后顺势连回，榨干白棋边空！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Execute the 3D Monkey Jump and connect smoothly along the edge!
templates.hintZh: 不要犹豫贴身扳，直接沿一路深潜伸腿！
templates.hintEn: Jump deep along the first line — White cannot cut you off.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：精准读出白棋两个抵抗分支，彻底击杀角上盘角曲四！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Read both of White's resistances to finish the corner Bent Four!
templates.hintZh: 第一手占 2-1 要点，白棋挡哪边都立刻跟进破眼。
templates.hintEn: Hit 2-1 first and answer either of White's two corner blocks cleanly.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：面对白棋强行突围，一记精准封头让白棋全军覆没！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Seal White's breakout head cleanly on either follow-up!
templates.hintZh: 当头镇住，白棋左右冲撞都落入接不归！
templates.hintEn: Cap directly in front — both follow-up pushes fail.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：双方均藏大眼暗气，精准抢占唯一先手要点胜出一气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Both sides hold hidden eye liberties — claim the sole winning point!
templates.hintZh: 直三大眼价值 3 口气，抢先护住大眼入口！
templates.hintEn: Protect the 3-space big eye entrance to outlast White by one tempo.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：面对复杂包围下的梅花五眼位，一击点穿花心绝杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Under heavy surrounding stones, pierce the Crossed Five center!
templates.hintZh: 认清真正的眼位形状仍是梅花五，正中一子定乾坤。
templates.hintEn: Look past the outer stones — the eye shape is a Crossed Five!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：高段死活试炼！外侧紧气缩眼与内部点杀完美衔接！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Master-level reading! Reduce outside first, then collapse the eye!
templates.hintZh: 切忌急于点内部，先从最右侧一路扳紧气缩成死形。
templates.hintEn: Resist playing inside first — hane on the far right 1st line to shrink the space.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：实战中极难一眼看出的双不入气手筋，一子立下定胜负！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Spot the hidden double-shortage Crane's Leg in a complex fight!
templates.hintZh: 看似两边危急，实则中间冷静一立令两块白棋同时不入气！
templates.hintEn: Ignore both sides and stand calmly in the center — double shortage of liberties!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：精确算清一路气紧反击，凭空刮出白棋角地！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Exploit White's subtle 1st-line shortage of liberties to raid the corner!
templates.hintZh: 直接一路扳入，白棋挡则立刻切断吃子。
templates.hintEn: Hane on the 1st line — White cannot block without losing stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗白子缩在角落里只剩一口气，提掉它们！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Capture the two cornered white stones on their last liberty!
templates.hintZh: 填上右边边线最后一口气就能提掉两颗白子！
templates.hintEn: Fill the last edge liberty to capture both white stones!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：左边黑子被叫吃了！快提掉中间 1 口气的白子来救它！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Save your endangered stone by capturing the 1-liberty white stone!
templates.hintZh: 中间白子只剩上方最后 1 口气，提掉它黑子就安全了。
templates.hintEn: Capture the center white stone on its top liberty!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋虎视眈眈要切断黑棋！快在边线把两块黑棋连成一片！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Connect your two black stones before White cuts them apart!
templates.hintZh: 下在两颗黑子中间的二路交叉点，稳稳手拉手。
templates.hintEn: Play right between your two black stones on the 2nd line.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：三颗白子排在边线上只剩最后一口气，一口全吃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Three white stones on the edge share 1 last liberty — capture them all!
templates.hintZh: 看边线右边唯一空着的那一口气。
templates.hintEn: Take the sole open liberty on the right of the edge stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：把二二位的白子逼向边线吃掉，千万别让它逃向中央！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Push the 2-2 white stone into the corner wall to capture!
templates.hintZh: 从二路把白棋往左角方向赶！
templates.hintEn: Atari from the right so White gets trapped in the corner.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：黑棋被三面围攻只剩一口气！往空处长气逃出生天！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Surrounded on three sides with 1 liberty — extend to escape!
templates.hintZh: 往右侧唯一空旷的方向长出一子。
templates.hintEn: Extend right into the open center for more liberties.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：找到同时叫吃两颗白子的宝藏点！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Find the treasure point that puts two white stones in atari!
templates.hintZh: 两颗白子各剩 2 口气，中间那个共享点就是双打吃！
templates.hintEn: Play on the liberty shared by both 2-liberty white stones!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：两颗白子就在门前，先叫吃逼它们一起钻进门里全吃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Atari both white stones straight into your door trap!
templates.hintZh: 从上方叫吃，白棋钻进两颗黑子中间后立刻关门。
templates.hintEn: Atari from above so White walks straight into your two doorposts.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：左边角上已经是真眼，快补住右边斜角缺口做成活棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Fix the diagonal corner of your right eye so it becomes a true eye!
templates.hintZh: 如果让白棋占住这个斜角点，右眼就会变成假眼。
templates.hintEn: Protect the diagonal point before White turns your eye false.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：边线黑子被白棋打吃了，立刻提掉旁边白子救回地盘！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Your edge stone is in atari — counter-capture the white stone!
templates.hintZh: 紧挨黑子的那颗白子也只剩 1 口气，直接提掉它！
templates.hintEn: Take the last liberty of the adjacent white stone!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：先叫吃边上白子，白棋如果硬连就会撞进接不归！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Atari the edge stones — connecting is fatal for White!
templates.hintZh: 从二路分断叫吃，白棋粘上后只剩 1 口气。
templates.hintEn: Cut on the 2nd line so connecting leaves White with 1 liberty.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：用轻灵的「枷」罩住出逃白子，千万别直接紧贴叫吃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Catch the escaping white stone with a loose net!
templates.hintZh: 在白子斜对角轻松一罩，它往哪边冲都只剩一口气。
templates.hintEn: Net diagonally across White's escape path.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：看似无路可逃，先送一子倒扑吃掉白棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Sacrifice one stone to trigger a lifesaving snapback!
templates.hintZh: 直接扑在白棋虎口里，白棋提掉反而全灭！
templates.hintEn: Throw into White's mouth — capturing lets you snap right back!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：连续两步叫吃把白棋滚成一团提光！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Two consecutive ataris squeeze and capture White!
templates.hintZh: 先从左边打吃，白棋粘上后紧接着收尾。
templates.hintEn: Atari from the left first, then finish the squeeze!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：把眼位守稳做成四目空间，白棋再也杀不死！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Expand to a 4-space eye along the edge to guarantee life!
templates.hintZh: 往右边一路挡住，稳稳围出四目活形。
templates.hintEn: Block on the right along the first line to secure 4 living spaces.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋左边已有一只眼，抢先冲破右边眼位杀掉白棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White has one eye on the left — destroy the right eye now!
templates.hintZh: 抢占右边二路要点，把白棋右眼变成假眼。
templates.hintEn: Play on the right 2nd-line point to turn White's right eye false.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：角上形成「曲四」宽敞眼位，守住拐点轻松活棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Secure the corner bend to guarantee two eyes!
templates.hintZh: 占住角部 2-1 要点，左右见合两眼活棋。
templates.hintEn: Play at the 2-1 bend for effortless corner life.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：双方都在抢气，记住「先紧外气」口诀拿下胜利！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Tight liberty race — fill White's outside liberty first!
templates.hintZh: 先紧白棋右边外气，别碰中间公气！
templates.hintEn: Take the outer right liberty first, never the shared liberty!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：右上角两颗黑子被叫吃了！记住「急所先于大场」，立刻救棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Urgent moves come before big moves — rescue your stones in atari!
templates.hintZh: 先救出右上角只剩 1 口气的黑子，别急着去拆空边。
templates.hintEn: Connect and rescue the endangered stones on the top right first!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：四个角都已落子，抢占宽阔的左边三路大场！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: All four corners are occupied — claim the huge left-side extension!
templates.hintZh: 在左上与左下两颗黑星位正中间的三路位置拆边。
templates.hintEn: Claim the balanced 3rd-line midpoint between your two left corners!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一路立下既护住角地又紧住白棋边气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Stand down on the 1st line to lock down corner territory!
templates.hintZh: 贴着白棋在一路稳稳立下。
templates.hintEn: Stand down solidly on the first line next to White.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋二路扳过来威胁冲断，稳稳挡住守住大空！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Block White's 2nd-line intrusion cleanly!
templates.hintZh: 在白棋前面一路挡下，同时防住断点。
templates.hintEn: Block firmly in front of White's 2nd-line hane.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一子跨断白棋飞形，左右必吃一边！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Cross-cut White's knight's move to capture a stone!
templates.hintZh: 切在白棋两子之间的薄弱交叉点。
templates.hintEn: Play on the cutting intersection between White's two stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：巧妙一挖让白棋左右首尾难顾，成功吃子联络！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Wedge on the 2nd line to shatter White's block and connect!
templates.hintZh: 下在两颗二路白子之间，哪边挡吃哪边。
templates.hintEn: Wedge right between White's two 2nd-line stones.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：沿一路巧妙一夹，白棋无法阻止黑棋两块连回！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Clamp on the 1st line to unite your two groups cleanly!
templates.hintZh: 在一路正中位置夹入，白棋左右挡不住。
templates.hintEn: Clamp at the center 1st-line point — miai to connect!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一路扳缩白棋四目空间，再精准点杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Hane on the 1st line to reduce White's 4-space eye to dead!
templates.hintZh: 先从右边一路扳进去，把四目缩成直三。
templates.hintEn: Hane from the right on the 1st line first.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一记一路「扑」将白棋的第二只眼化为假眼！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Throw in on the edge to destroy White's second eye!
templates.hintZh: 扑入右边眼位，白棋提子后变成假眼死棋。
templates.hintEn: Throw in on the right — White's capture only makes a false eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：先在角部立下给自己延气，再反客为主赢下对杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Extend in the corner first to flip the liberty count!
templates.hintZh: 千万别直接撞白棋外气，先给角上黑子长出两口气。
templates.hintEn: Stand down in the corner to gain two crucial liberties.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：先在角上做出一只稳固真眼，公气全归黑棋！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Make a single true eye in the corner to own every shared liberty!
templates.hintZh: 「有眼杀无眼」——先补成左上角真眼！
templates.hintEn: Make one true corner eye first!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：19 路经典开局，对左下白星位下出标准小飞挂！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Approach White's bottom-left 4-4 with a Knight's Move!
templates.hintZh: 在左下白星位右侧三路（F3 位置）小飞挂角。
templates.hintEn: Approach on the 3rd line a knight's move right of White's bottom-left star point.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋直接点三三抢角！黑棋该挡在宽阔且有己方呼应的哪一边？
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White invades 3-3! Block on the side cooperating with your corner!
templates.hintZh: 黑棋右下角有星位呼应，挡在右侧（Q16）筑起面向右边的宏大外势！
templates.hintEn: Block on the right side (Q16) to build a wall facing your bottom-right star point!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：精准下出二路先手扳粘，白棋只能老实挡住！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the 2nd-line sente hane and connect cleanly!
templates.hintZh: 二路扳入，白棋挡住后立刻粘回。
templates.hintEn: Hane on the 2nd line and connect solidly after White blocks.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：沿一路使出大伸腿官子，一举削减白棋大片边空！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Play the 1st-line Monkey Jump to slash White's side territory!
templates.hintZh: 一路小飞伸腿潜入白棋下方。
templates.hintEn: Leap along the first line under White's wall.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：空间狭小但暗藏生机，抢占二一路要点见合做活！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Claim the 2-1 vital point to create miai for two eyes!
templates.hintZh: 下在角部 2-1 核心位置，白棋无法同时破掉两处眼位。
templates.hintEn: Play on the 2-1 point for miai corner life.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一记「扑」破掉白棋真眼，顺势赢下整场对杀！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Throw in to remove White's eye and win the race!
templates.hintZh: 扑在白棋眼位中心，白棋提子立刻掉气。
templates.hintEn: Throw directly into White's eye to win the liberty race.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：一眼看穿白棋气紧缺陷，弃一子倒扑全吃！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Spot White's shortage of liberties and execute the snapback!
templates.hintZh: 一路直接扑入，等白棋提子后反手全提！
templates.hintEn: Throw in on the 1st line and snap back after White captures!

templates.promptZh: 黑先：无法净活时切忌乱扑送死，冷静做出「双活」平安脱险！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Don't self-destruct trying for two eyes — secure a clean Seki!
templates.hintZh: 立在右侧形成两口公气的双活棋形。
templates.hintEn: Stand down calmly on the right to form a peaceful Seki.

templates.titleZh: 初段小目一间高挂应手
templates.promptZh: 黑先：白棋对右上小目「一间高挂」，三路托入角地最简明有力！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: White plays the high approach against your 3-4 — attach underneath!
templates.hintZh: 三路贴身托住白子，准备抢占扎实的角部实地。
templates.hintEn: Attach underneath on the 3rd line to claim solid corner cash.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：分毫不差的初段对杀！先抢外侧一路破眼再紧公气！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Exact 1D capturing race — take the outer 1st-line point first!
templates.hintZh: 先紧白棋最右侧一路，绝不给白棋做眼喘息机会。
templates.hintEn: Take the far right 1st-line point first so White has no eye.

templates.promptZh: 黑先：官子胜负只差一目！抢占二路逆收大官子锁定胜局！
templates.promptEn: Black to play: Close game — claim the 2nd-line reverse sente endgame to win!
templates.hintZh: 抢先在二路挡住，不让白棋先手扳粘！
templates.hintEn: Take the 2nd-line point before White gets a sente hane.
